patthana15.85:1.1: araṇaṃ maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na maggārammaṇo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.85:2.1: araṇaṃ maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.85:3.1: araṇaṃ maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. saraṇaduka uppannattike nasaraṇaduka nauppannattikaṃ
